name: bikeinspect
description: Sistem Inspeksi Kendaraan Bermotor Roda Dua — Aplikasi Web Mobile-First

scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build:cpanel: VITE_BASE_PATH=/bikeinspect/ npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
